informal_statement: GSE142439 paired normal/treated methylation arrays, read through Horvath353 coefficients, support only a local age_signature clock shift when treated DNAm age is lower than paired normal DNAm age.

distinctions: M: paired methylation beta matrix restricted to covered Horvath353 CpGs
W: Horvath353 coefficient table with intercept
P: eight normal/treated person-level pairs
S_A: Horvath DNAm age readback
Δ_A: treated minus normal paired age delta
L: age_signature layer label
N: no-promotion boundary for identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, renewable maintenance, and immortality
bedc_minimal_form.readback: Apply Horvath353 weights to each covered CpG beta vector, transform the clock sum to DNAm age, and compare treated against normal within each person.

null_reason: If coverage, pairing, mean direction, or paired sign/t criterion fails, the packet is needs_data and cannot be promoted beyond age_signature.

bedc_minimal_form.readback: Apply Horvath353 weights to the frozen beta matrix, compare treated against normal within each donor, summarize mean deltas by cell type, and recompute the overall mean after excluding each donor once.

informal_statement: Within the frozen GSE142439 paired normal/treated methylation arrays scored by Horvath353, the age_signature clock shift is treated as directionally robust only when both cell-type strata have negative mean paired DNAm age deltas and every leave-one-donor-out overall mean delta remains negative.
null_reason: If either cell-type stratum has a nonnegative mean delta or any leave-one-donor-out mean is nonnegative, the packet is needs_data; even if directionally robust, it remains null for cell identity, function, safety, rejuvenation, renewable maintenance, organismal maintenance, and immortality.

P: three donor-matched exp2 day-10 negative-control/transiently-reprogrammed pairs

L: cell_identity layer label
N: no-promotion boundary for safety and downstream claims
bedc_minimal_form.readback: Compare treated-minus-control marker deltas within each donor using fixed identity RMS and pluripotency delta thresholds.

forbidden_claims: sameSig_I alone does not establish IdentityPreservingAgeResetUp.
